status: ADOPTED into the authority ladder at level 3 (kit laws). These are DATA for the validator and for agents; the human's explicit words and project locked documents still outrank them. Their selftest (102/102) passed as delivered, which is why they were accepted rather than re-derived.

laws._comment: The portable authoring law. Applies to every project in this universe and to any project a new agent opens.

failure_modes.symptom: The serial never asked what canon says happens in that forest. Canon says people hunt there for rings.
failure_modes.cure: Name at least five canon beats the serial touches, before drafting.

failure_modes.symptom: No antagonist pressure. The protagonist was never wanted by anyone for anything.
failure_modes.cure: Every chapter gets a threat and a named face.

failure_modes.symptom: Rank and ring changes were asserted in panels but never earned on the page.
failure_modes.cure: Ring gates are chapter rhythm, not decoration.

failure_modes.symptom: Fifteen chapters in a single interior-meditation voice. Dialogue vanished from seven of them.
failure_modes.cure: Five registers, at least three per chapter, counted not eyeballed.

failure_modes.symptom: Panels, ledgers and codex entries became the product; the story became the appendix.
failure_modes.cure: Slim panel at top, no chapter footer, prose carries the weight.

pipeline.detail: Read the live edge and the locks
Update ledgers and the serial log

predraft_gate.detail: Rebuild the relevant canon scene by scene. Not from memory - from receipts. If a scene is missing, say it is missing.
Event order, location, timing, positions, clothing, objects, environment, dialogue style, motivations, character knowledge.
Timeline, location, prop, power and adaptation, knowledge - who knows what, and since when.
Hide information from characters who have not earned it. Author knowledge is never character knowledge. Check every speaking character against the registry.
Use the authority hierarchy. User words beat project docs beat kit laws. Record the resolution, not just the result.
Only now set beat order. Set the panel year range first. Then draft.

twelve_locks.question: Which series, which years, which DC range
Who they are - and explicitly what they are NOT
The specific canon beats this serial touches. Name at least five.
Who wants what from the protagonist, and what they will do to get it
The strongest the OC becomes, and what they never get
Public name versus true name; what the reveal costs
What the protagonist will never do, ever
Which canon characters' fates may not be rerouted
How rank and rings are shown on the page
Chapters per pass, words per chapter, when audits run
What a fresh agent must read first

laws.lock_4_rule: Write it as a full sentence with all three blanks filled: '______ wants ______ from my protagonist, and will ______ to get it.' If you cannot fill all three, there is no story yet - there is only a setting.

seven_gates.why: CJK, kana, hangul. Not a blanket non-ASCII ban - em dashes and box-drawing are fine.
The two-character sequence leaking into prose from escaped strings. Use the real newline.
Exact figures belong in panels and ledgers. Prose says 'seven', the panel says '7'.

seven_gates.gate: At least three spoken dialogue lines
seven_gates.why: Dialogue silently disappears from introspective serials. It went missing from seven of fifteen chapters in one rebuild and was only caught by counting. Count it; do not eyeball it.
No overlap, no gap. Insertion and reordering desynchronise panels, and the drift is invisible until two chapters claim the same year.
No shipped file contains template slots or lorem-style filler.
The book-end marker never appears in prose; at most one end card, opening with END OF, last in the file.

laws.gate_scope_warning: Gate 6 must never be applied to templates, law files, or audit logs. A template with no slot tokens is not a template. A law file that cannot show the panel format cannot teach it. An audit log reports on placeholder counts - a line reading 'TODO/FIXME/TBD = 0' is the log doing its job, not a leftover. Gates 1 and 2 are the only ones that apply everywhere, because they are the ones that indicate a file is broken rather than a file being what it is.
laws.self_referential_trap: A check must not match its own description. Five confirmed instances: a blanket non-ASCII gate flagging the em dashes in the prose law that explains the rule; a case-insensitive substring flagging 'placeholder' inside 'no placeholder text left'; gate 6 over templates flagging every slot token; gate 6 over an audit log flagging its own zero-count report; and documenting that last case inside the audit law re-tripping the same class. Scope the gate, do not reword the file.
laws.negative_test_rule: Ship the negative test with the gate. tools/selftest.py exists because verify.py once reported fifteen failures against a proven 33,100-word serial - every one of them a false positive. A gate nobody has tested is a guess.

firewall_states.permits: May act on it and speak of it
May act on the part held; must not extend it by assumption
May worry, probe, deflect - may not state as fact
Needs direct proof to move; will rationalise anomalies first
Cannot reference it, hint at it, or intuit it
Acts on the false version; the truth must be earned on page
Declared but not yet used in any registry

laws.leak_paths: Never convert suspicion, intuition, rumour, or prophecy fragments into factual character knowledge without evidence. Never give a character information earlier than the earliest valid change recorded in their firewall. Predetermined destiny does not pre-install personal memories or trust. Instinctive power control after an awakening does not equal encyclopaedic lore.

adaptation_talent.is: An innate, non-conscious, existence-level personal law or instinct belonging to the user's OC. It adapts from the complete current foundation.

requirements.detail: There must be something there to adapt. It cannot create power from absolute nothing.
The adaptation becomes part of the character, not a bolted-on ability.
The character must actually encounter the thing being adapted to.
Adaptation costs something and changes something. No free power.

adaptation_talent.primary_abuse: Do not use this framework to justify a character knowing lore they have not learned. Adaptation is not a knowledge pipe. It changes what a character can do; it never installs what a character knows.
adaptation_talent.setting_bound: Adaptation cannot bypass setting rules. It operates inside the setting's physics - it is not an exemption from them.

authority_order: Earlier projects - craft only, never canon
